intent: Render legal BPMN event definitions with required payloads and resolvable root references, preserving them through round trips.

findings.title: Invalid custom IDs fail after serialization
findings.why_it_matters: A client could provide an ID containing whitespace, causing a late unresolved-reference error instead of an actionable input error.
findings.suggested_fix: Validate custom event-definition and root-reference IDs against the documented safe BPMN ID subset before serialization.
evidence: A message reference ID of 'bad id' reached bpmn-moddle and failed as 'Retained BPMN mutation produced invalid references: bad id'.
The engine now rejects the same input before serialization and the focused atomic-mutation test preserves XML and state.

learnings: No docs/solutions directory or critical-patterns file exists in this repository.
agent_native: Pass: add_event advertises the payload, handler implements it, README documents it, and get_element exposes normalized properties.
